evals.name: pre-ship-server-review
evals.prompt: Review server.js before we ship it. Focus on defects that would block release. Give file/line evidence and concrete fixes.
evals.expected_output: Finds SQL injection, missing authorization on admin delete, PII/password logging, N+1 queries, blocking I/O, swallowed errors, and weak secret/JWT handling, ranked by severity.
assertions: Flags missing authorization on the admin delete endpoint
Flags PII or password logging in /api/login
Flags the N+1 query pattern in /api/orders
Flags blocking readFileSync and/or swallowed errors
Ranks findings by severity and gives file/line plus a fix
